content.title: Adopt-a-Street
content.summary: The Adopt-A-Street Program in Arvada invites individuals and groups to volunteer for litter collection on local streets, parks, and waterways, committing to clean their adopted area at least four times a year. The city provides necessary supplies and recognizes volunteers with signage on the adopted streets. Interested participants can apply online and suggest new routes for adoption.
content.body:
Help keep Arvada Beautiful by volunteering for the Adopt-A-Street Program, and collecting litter from our community streets, parks, green belts, and waterways.

## How Does Adopt a Street Work

- Individuals or groups volunteer to pick up litter on streets in Arvada.
- Volunteers enter into a written agreement with the City and agree to clean the adopted street or site a minimum of four times per year.
- The City provides trash bags and safety vests and will collect the filled bags when the volunteers have completed the litter pickup.
- Signs are posted on the adopted streets to recognize the efforts of volunteers, civic groups, churches, or businesses.

## Available Streets

Routes are selected from a priority list. If you know of a street that needs to be cleaned but is not on our list, please suggest it so we can make it a route. To see current routes, and whether a route is available for adoption, explore our interactive map.

[Launch Route Map](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=a94a4acb58814af18c5ffc68d9f7d1c3)

## How to Adopt a Street

Submit a request online, including the route you would like to suggest and your contact information, to start the process of adopting a street. The program is designed to help keep Arvada clean and attractive for its citizens. Thank you for considering the adoption of a street!

[Apply to Adopt a Street](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/32094).

## Questions & Route Suggestions

If you have questions about this program or would like to suggest a new route, please [email Michele Broski](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#2f424d5d405c44466f4e5d594e4b4e01405d48), Adopt-a-Street Coordinator, or call 720-898-7692.
